label: Federal continuity (COOP)
description: A federal executive branch department, agency or component exercising its continuity plan under Federal Continuity Directive 1 and 2: activation, relocation to an alternate site, devolution of authority to another office, performance of mission and primary mission essential functions, orders of succession, delegations of authority, essential records, continuity communications and reconstitution. Scenarios use a fictional agency and fictional officials.

vocabulary.facility: the agency's headquarters, its alternate and devolution sites and its field offices
vocabulary.public: the public, Congress, the media, regulated parties and partner agencies
vocabulary.frontline: emergency relocation group members, devolution emergency response group members, mission owners' staff, telework staff
vocabulary.operationsCenter: the agency operations center and the continuity operations center at the alternate site

roles.name: Continuity Coordinator (Senior Accountable Official)
roles.description: The senior accountable official for the continuity program: recommends activation to the agency head, directs relocation or devolution, and validates the after-action report.

roles.name: Continuity Manager (Continuity Operations Center Director)
roles.description: Runs the continuity operations center: activation checklists, emergency relocation group accountability, alternate-site readiness and status reports to FEMA.

roles.name: Mission Owner (Primary Mission Essential Function)
roles.description: Owns an essential function: decides which tasks must run, in what order, with which staff, and reports whether the function is performed.

roles.name: Chief Information Officer / CISO
roles.description: Owns the continuity network, replicated data, remote access and communications; decides what to isolate, fail over or restore.

roles.name: Facilities and Security Manager
roles.description: Owns headquarters evacuation, alternate-site access, security, transportation, lodging and supplies for the relocated group.

roles.name: Devolution Site Director
roles.description: Leads the devolution emergency response group at the devolution site and takes command and control when the headquarters cannot perform its functions.

roles.name: Human Capital Officer
roles.description: Owns personnel accountability, the recall roster, emergency pay, family communication and the reconstitution of the workforce.

roles.name: Public Affairs Director (PIO)
roles.description: Owns messages to employees, the public, Congress and the media about the agency's status and when services resume.
